evidence: Multi-stage Android toll fraud operation targeting Poland: fake PDF-expiry Facebook ads lead to Google Play apps whose hidden loader chain (base APK -> country gate -> payload router -> fraud payload) enrolls victims in premium SMS and carrier-billing subscriptions without consent. Indicators observed/recovered 14-21 Sep 2026. Reported by CERT Polska (2026-09-23): https://cert.pl/en/posts/2026/09/tollfraud-analysis/
